text:
One rule we follow with every client: everything we build stays in their accounts.

The website, the domain, the Google Business Profile, the ad accounts, the WhatsApp number, the automation. All of it in the client's name.

Why say this out loud? Because many small businesses discover, when they leave an agency, that:
→ The domain was registered in the agency's name
→ The ad account history went with the agency
→ The website can't be moved without paying again

If you're hiring anyone for digital work, ask one question before you start: "If we stop working together, what do I keep?"

The answer should be: everything.

Want this fixed in your business? WhatsApp me: +91 98131 36114
